Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, frail but determined. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

JACOB: (tearfully) Oh, Thank You. I Am Truly Honored.

The officials and reporters swarm around him, congratulating him on his achievement. Jacob smiles, basking in the attention.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the certificate and plaque on his nightstand. He gazes at them, a look of nostalgia on his face. He begins to speak to himself, lost in thought.

JACOB: (whispering) I Remember Reading About This Theory... Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Live Long Enough, You'll Eventually Experience Every Possible Outcome of Every Decision You've Ever Made.

He pauses, his eyes glazing over.

JACOB: (whispering) It Said That I'd Live Every Life, Every Possibility. That I'd Be Every Person, Every Experience. The Weight Of It All Became Too Much.

Jacob's voice rises, his words becoming a frantic whisper.

JACOB: (whispering) What If I'm Not Just One Person? What If I'm Every Person? What If I'm Every Experience? The Thought Consumes Me.

Jacob's eyes roll back in his head, and he begins to thrash about in bed. He screams, his voice echoing through the room.

JACOB: (screaming) I'M EVERYONE! I'M EVERYTHING! I'M THE SUM OF ALL POSSIBILITIES!

The camera zooms in on Jacob's face, his eyes wild and unfocused. He's lost in a sea of madness, unable to escape the crushing weight of his own existence.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - LATER

Jacob lies in bed, his body still. The certificate and plaque are gone, replaced by a single sheet of paper. On it is a message, scrawled in Jacob's own handwriting:

"I AM EVERYONE. I AM EVERYTHING. I AM THE QUANTUM IMMORTAL."

The camera lingers on the paper, the words seeming to pulse with an otherworldly energy. The screen fades to black, leaving the audience to ponder the true nature of Jacob's existence.
